scenarios.title: A｜询问情况
scenarios.setting: 玩家回家后发现客厅里又有几个不认识的人。第二天询问室友。

turns.prompt: 你想了解室友最近频繁邀请朋友来访的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, were those your friends here last night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, were those your friends here last night?
feedback.explanation: “last night”表示过去的时间段，前面通常不加介词。

choices.text: You’ve had people over quite a lot lately. Is something going on?

feedback.naturalExpression: You’ve had people over quite a lot lately. Is something going on?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Hey, are your friends going to be coming over regularly?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, are your friends going to be coming over regularly?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: I noticed we’ve had guests over several nights this week. I wanted to ask you about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I noticed we’ve had guests over several nights this week. I wanted to ask you about it.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

turns.text: Yeah, they’re just friends from work. Why?

turns.prompt: 你想了解访客来访的频率，会怎么说？

choices.text: I was just wondering how often they’re going to be here.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was just wondering how often they’re going to be here.
feedback.explanation: “How often”问频率，也就是多久一次，而非一次持续多久。

choices.text: I don’t mind you having friends over. I just wasn’t expecting people here so often.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t mind you having friends over. I just wasn’t expecting people here so often.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I wanted to ask because we’re sharing the living room and kitchen.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted to ask because we’re sharing the living room and kitchen.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: I’m not saying they can’t come over. I’d just like to know what’s going on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not saying they can’t come over. I’d just like to know what’s going on.
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

turns.text: Oh. I didn’t realize it was bothering you.

turns.prompt: 你想说明你在意的是提前沟通，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s not the guests themselves. I just want us to communicate about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s not the guests themselves. I just want us to communicate about it.
feedback.explanation: “I just want”强调自己真正希望解决的事，能把讨论拉回具体诉求。

choices.text: It’s mostly that I don’t know when people are going to be here.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s mostly that I don’t know when people are going to be here.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

scenarios.title: B｜提出提前通知
scenarios.setting: 在“室友经常带朋友回来”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“提出提前通知”。

turns.text: A couple of friends might come over tonight. Is that okay?

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, that’s fine. Thanks for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s fine. Thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Sure. Could you just give me a heads-up beforehand when people are coming over?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Could you just give me a heads-up beforehand when people are coming over?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I don’t mind guests. I’d just appreciate some notice in advance.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t mind guests. I’d just appreciate some notice in advance.
feedback.explanation: “in advance”表示提前；用来确认手续或通知需要提前多久，能问清时间要求。

choices.text: Could you text me before you invite people over? It helps me plan around it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you text me before you invite people over? It helps me plan around it.
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Please tell me earlier before your friends come.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s fine. Thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: “earlier before”有重复感；提前告知可说“let me know in advance”或“give me a heads-up”。

turns.text: How much notice do you need?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认人数或数量，你会怎样说明需求？

choices.text: Even a few hours would be helpful.

feedback.naturalExpression: Even a few hours would be helpful.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: Ideally, just let me know earlier in the day.

feedback.naturalExpression: Ideally, just let me know earlier in the day.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: It doesn’t have to be far in advance. I just don’t want to walk in and be surprised.

feedback.naturalExpression: It doesn’t have to be far in advance. I just don’t want to walk in and be surprised.
feedback.explanation: “in advance”表示提前；用来确认手续或通知需要提前多久，能问清时间要求。

choices.text: If it’s going to be a bigger group, I’d prefer to know the day before.

feedback.naturalExpression: If it’s going to be a bigger group, I’d prefer to know the day before.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I really appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I really appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

choices.text: Great. I think that’ll make things much easier.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I think that’ll make things much easier.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

scenarios.title: C｜设置共同规则
scenarios.setting: 两人决定正式谈一下访客问题。

turns.prompt: 关于「室友经常带朋友回来」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I think we should agree on some basic rules for having guests over.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we should agree on some basic rules for having guests over.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Maybe we should set some ground rules about visitors.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we should set some ground rules about visitors.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Since we both share the apartment, I think we should agree on what we’re both comfortable with.

feedback.naturalExpression: Since we both share the apartment, I think we should agree on what we’re both comfortable with.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I don’t want either of us to feel like we need permission to have friends over, but we do need some boundaries.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want either of us to feel like we need permission to have friends over, but we do need some boundaries.
feedback.explanation: “boundaries”指个人界限，说明哪些互动是自己能够接受的。

turns.prompt: 你想提出一条适合共同生活的访客规则，会怎么说？

choices.text: Maybe no large groups on weeknights.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe no large groups on weeknights.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: I’d like us to let each other know before someone stays overnight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like us to let each other know before someone stays overnight.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Could we keep things quiet after eleven?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we keep things quiet after eleven?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: And if someone is going to be here for several days, I think we should talk about it first.

feedback.naturalExpression: And if someone is going to be here for several days, I think we should talk about it first.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: That seems fair. But I don’t want to have to ask permission every time a friend comes over.

turns.prompt: 你想表达认同或相似的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: I agree. I’m not asking you to get permission. I just want a heads-up.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree. I’m not asking you to get permission. I just want a heads-up.
feedback.explanation: “I just want”强调自己真正希望解决的事，能把讨论拉回具体诉求。

choices.text: That’s fair. I think there’s a difference between informing each other and asking permission.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fair. I think there’s a difference between informing each other and asking permission.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Exactly. The goal is just to make sure we’re both comfortable in our own home.

feedback.naturalExpression: Exactly. The goal is just to make sure we’re both comfortable in our own home.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

turns.text: Okay. I can agree to that.

turns.prompt: 你想确认共同规则也同样适用于自己，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. And obviously the same rules apply to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. And obviously the same rules apply to me.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: Perfect. I think that’ll work for both of us.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I think that’ll work for both of us.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。
